title: Kushenol O Regulates GALNT7/NF-kappaB axis-Mediated Macrophage M2 Polarization and Efferocytosis in Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma.
authors: Li, Yutong; Miao, Jianhang; Liu, Chizhuai; Tao, Jiahua; Zhou, Sifan; Song, Xingyu; Zou, Yecheng; Huang, Yuyang; Zhong, Linkun
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Kushenol O通过GALNT7/NF-kappaB轴调控甲状腺乳头状癌巨噬细胞极化，核心为肿瘤免疫与药物机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模，仅分子模拟验证亲和力，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The incidence of papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) is on the rise globally. It is frequently associated with early lymphatic metastasis, and the poor prognosis tends to be poor once metastasis or recurrence occurs, even with current treatment modalities. Kushenol O, a novel extract derived from Sophora flavescens, has shown remarkable anticancer properties. However, its specific role in the treatment of PTC remains to be elucidated. PURPOSE: This objective of this study is to examine the effects of kushenol O on the proliferation and invasion capacity of PTC cells, as well as to delve into its potential mechanisms of action. METHODS: Multi-omics was employed to identify the potential therapeutic targets for PTC. Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) investigated how these targets influence the remodeling of the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME). Kushenol O was employed to treat the PTC cell lines, with assessments conducted on its effects regarding cell viability, apoptosis, oxidative stress, and invasiveness. Molecular simulation was used to validate kushenol O's affinity for the therapeutic targets and biological toxicity. The impact of kushenol O was further evaluated using qRT-PCR and EdU assays, while cytotoxicity was measured by the CCK-8. RESULTS: GALNT7 is a potential new target for the treatment of PTC. It may regulate the macrophage M2 polarization and efferocytosis in the TIME of PTC through regulating the NF-kappaB axis. Kushenol O inhibits PTC cells proliferation and promotes apoptosis by inhibiting the expression of GALNT7, induces a decrease in SOD levels and an increase in MDA levels by inhibiting mitochondrial function, and promotes the accumulation of ROS, which inhibits G1 phase and promotes early apoptosis. CONCLUSIONS: Kushenol O may inhibit the inflammation-cancer transformation and tumor progression of PTC by inhibiting GALNT7 and thus regulating NF-kappaB axis. These findings highlight the potential of kushenol O as immunomodulator or therapeutic agent, which may have important clinical implications.
abstract_zh: 背景：甲状腺乳头状癌（PTC）的发病率在全球范围内呈上升趋势。它常伴有早期淋巴转移，且一旦发生转移或复发，即使采用现有治疗手段，预后也往往较差。Kushenol O，一种从苦参（Sophora flavescens）中提取的新型化合物，已显示出显著的抗癌特性。然而，其在PTC治疗中的具体作用仍有待阐明。目的：本研究旨在探讨kushenol O对PTC细胞增殖和侵袭能力的影响，并深入探究其潜在的作用机制。方法：采用多组学方法识别PTC的潜在治疗靶点。单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）用于研究这些靶点如何影响肿瘤免疫微环境（TIME）的重塑。使用kushenol O处理PTC细胞系，评估其对细胞活力、凋亡、氧化应激和侵袭能力的影响。分子模拟用于验证kushenol O与治疗靶点的亲和力及生物毒性。通过qRT-PCR和EdU实验进一步评估kushenol O的作用，而细胞毒性则通过CCK-8法测定。结果：GALNT7是治疗PTC的潜在新靶点。它可能通过调控NF-kappaB轴来调节PTC的TIME中巨噬细胞M2极化和胞葬作用。Kushenol O通过抑制GALNT7表达来抑制PTC细胞增殖并促进凋亡，通过抑制线粒体功能诱导SOD水平下降和MDA水平升高，并促进ROS积累，从而抑制G1期并促进早期凋亡。结论：Kushenol O可能通过抑制GALNT7进而调控NF-kappaB轴，从而抑制PTC的炎症-癌症转化和肿瘤进展。这些发现凸显了kushenol O作为免疫调节剂或治疗剂的潜力，可能具有重要的临床意义。
